items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Jule Hill directly; the interviewer identifies Jule Hill as the drummer for 'Johnson Serenade', a group the interviewee mentions playing with, but the interviewee's response focuses on the bandleader 'Johnson' and other band members, showing no direct personal intera

ctx.x: I didn't play, I played with, uh, Johnson Serenade, this down in Fres Adfield. Uh, but Johnson, what did that thing?
Uh, Johnson Serenade, this, the, Jule Hill was the drummer. Yeah, I used to work with him.
She used to work with him. She used to work with him. What's his name, Johnson? Johnson, yeah. You want to, you want to ask her? Mm-hmm. Well, that's not too far from Chicago. Uh-huh.
